top_signals.title: China warns US space weapons could fuel arms race
top_signals.summary: China urged the United States to halt its military build-up in outer space after Washington acknowledged it has weapons deployed in orbit.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Spain’s Indra proffers ‘Squall’ for Europe’s emerging strike missile mix
top_signals.summary: Spain’s Indra has launched a low-cost cruise missile it claims will cost a tenth of top-of-the line current missiles, enabling swarm tactics.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
